claim_text: Have all of our businesses identify at least one critical health hazard material to their business and demonstrate a year-on-year reduction of exposure to that hazard.
metric_name: Assets achieving an exposure reduction to known health risks
context_text: Have all of our businesses identify at least one critical health hazard material to their business and demonstrate a year-on-year reduction of exposure to that hazard.；14 of our assets across Rio Tinto achieved an exposure reduction to known health risks (airborne contaminants and noise). (2024: 6 assets).；We implemented 22 targeted projects across 14 assets to successfully reduce exposures to known health risks for our employees and contractors.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: FY25有14个资产实现了已知健康风险暴露下降，且相关减暴项目在正文中被进一步说明，支持充分。
notes: 证据合并自绩效目标页与职业健康章节。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that all businesses will (1) identify at least one critical health hazard material to their business and (2) demonstrate a year‑on‑year reduction of exposure to that hazard. The evidence substantiates that exposure reductions were achieved at some scale: it states that 14 assets achieved an exposure reduction to known health risks (airborne contaminants and noise) and provides a prior-year figure of 6 assets, and notes 22 targeted projects across those 14 assets to reduce exposures. However, the evidence does not verify the “all of our businesses” scope (it reports results for 14 assets, not all businesses), does not show that each business identified at least one critical health hazard material to its business, and does not demonstrate year‑on‑year exposure reduction at the business level (it only shows a change in the count of assets achieving reductions, not year‑on‑year exposure reductions for each business/hazard).
